title: Classic Coins
description: Adds copper, iron, gold, and emerald coins with optional crafting recipes.
body:
# Classic Coins
Classic Coins adds four currency-style items: copper coin, iron coin, gold coin, and emerald coin.

## Features
- Four coins: Copper, Iron, Gold, Emerald
- Per-coin crafting toggles through a generated config file
- Dedicated Classic Coins creative tab

## Recipes
Each coin recipe uses 5 of its source material in a plus shape:

- 5 Copper Ingots -> 1 Copper Coin
- 5 Iron Ingots -> 1 Iron Coin
- 5 Gold Ingots -> 1 Gold Coin
- 5 Emeralds -> 1 Emerald Coin

Copper, iron, and gold coins can be blasted back into 5 of their original ingots. Emerald coins cannot be returned through furnace recipes.

## Configuration
On first launch, the mod creates `config/classiccoins.json`.

Set any value to `false` to disable that coin's recipe:

```json
{
	"copper_coin_recipe_enabled": true,
	"iron_coin_recipe_enabled": true,
	"gold_coin_recipe_enabled": true,
	"emerald_coin_recipe_enabled": true
}
```

Disabled recipes are skipped at load time, so they do not appear in normal crafting.

## Bug Reports
If you hit any issue, open a ticket on [GitHub](https://github.com/acorsicanfrog/classic-coins/issues).
